scope: Bounded Android native pilot: public stock search, latest stored quote and connected Compose/manual-price draft; local debug APK on API 33. Not complete app, production deployment or all-device approval.

reviewer.role: separate test author and implementation reviewer
reviewer.independence_limit: Reviewer did not author production implementation, but authored the initial feature/device criteria and later backend/regression tests. This is not independent certification of the reviewer own test expectations.

decision_basis: Read selected KB packets first, then source/specification and raw verification artifacts. No new web research, Gradle build, device operation or DB operation by this review role.
All 35 verification-05 source hashes equal current files; current implementation, frozen criteria, additive tests, build/dependency files, specifications and KB gate code are bound below.

All seven referenced XML hashes match actual XML files. Parsed case counts and failure/error/skipped elements independently match 52 JVM, 7 actual Kotlin-to-Rust/PostgreSQL, and 5 API33 instrumented device tests.
Both APK hashes and the actual Gradle acceptance log hash match verification-05. Lint XML contains zero errors and nine warnings.

Actual API33 Compose-to-Rust/PostgreSQL probe passed all four checks. Probe uses exact verified APK, localhost-emulator backend origin, native UI search and selection; screenshot hash matches and screenshot visually shows Samsung, 71000.125 KRW, 2026-10-23, and native input 71000.125.

Rust fixture report confirms locked/offline build, fresh local DB creation, 53 migrations and synthetic seed success. Current Rust source hashes and built binary equal fixture report. No original server/env or production DB used by fixture script.
Executed read-only android_knowledge.verify for each actual search/price/integration manifest+usage with expected_task binding: all pass. Current frozen criteria also match.

resolved_findings.resolution: Removed query reset; keeps raw query, resets only selected-price draft and reissues normalized current query after 250ms. Additive regression failed before fix, passes now.

resolved_findings.finding: KB manifest could omit required document/source/task binding
resolved_findings.resolution: verify now checks expected task, feature/platform, exact configured document set, derived source set, readiness, source/context hashes and complete nonblank usage map. android_pilot final repeats all three task-bound KB checks and current frozen-criteria checks. 11 gate-specific tests pass; existing 19 knowledge-readiness tests are a separate suite.

resolved_findings.finding: search decoder accepted invalid JSON-number grammar
resolved_findings.resolution: Central regression reproduced accepted invalid token before fix. Search now applies anchored JSON-number grammar before exact BigDecimal-to-Long safe bound. New search grammar and price-control tests pass; original 49 criteria unchanged.

knowledge_gate.limitations: Packet hashes/use declarations prove materialized inputs and declared mappings, not actual model comprehension. Initial search/price implementation predates the gate; retrospective audit remains labeled as such. Integration packet was required before start.

prior_failures_preserved: Initial API red: 20 failures against independent blank snapshot. Initial core integration red: 49 failures; instrumented tests were authored then but not run at red stage.
Review regressions: two reproduced defects and one passing price-grammar control before fixes; unchanged new criterion hash now passes.
Device criteria v2 removed only an invalid top-level import; all assertions unchanged and v1/v2 hashes preserved.
Earlier build failures (missing app OkHttp dependency, invalid test import, lint includeSubdomains requirements) remain separate from final successful run.

First direct-device attempt failed setup because instrumentation cleanup removed APK; next attempt failed while IME obscured results. Both prior failure artifacts remain; device-rust-03 is a distinct passing corrected probe.
remaining_limits: Only one API33 ARM64 emulator tested; no physical-device or other Android-version compatibility claim.

Activity recreation and dirty draft retention tested; actual OS process-kill restoration, full background/return/device resource-pressure behavior, TalkBack and large-font/IME manual acceptance are not fully validated.
Release HTTPS endpoint remains intentionally unconfigured; this is a local debug pilot, not a deployable production release. Lint dependency-update, icon and data-extraction-rule warnings remain.
No login/session/transaction save/exchange-rate/full-service UI implementation or validation.

The 7 Rust/DB acceptance tests were authored after initial feature implementation; only original 49 JVM criteria are first-implementation test-first. The 3 review regressions were written before their fixes.
No sequential control run exists, so no quantified speedup/productivity claim is supported.
KB understanding and reviewer-owned test expectations are not independently certified by metadata, test passes or this review.
Fixture teardown is coordinator-owned and was still serving when read; passing functional validation does not assert that subsequent cleanup has already occurred.
approval_validity: Approval applies to these exact reviewed source hashes and bounded evidence. Functional source/test/build changes require affected verification and review again; report-only additions do not constitute tested production changes.
